Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.</p> <p>Empowering the world starts with living <a href="https://ouraring.com/about-us">our values</a> and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.&nbsp;</p></div><p>As the Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) for Manufacturing, you will be the primary bridge between Product Development (PD) and Global Manufacturing Operations. You are the single point of contact for all manufacturing process development and deployment within the PD program. Your mission is to ensure that every piece of custom automation, tooling, and test equipment is designed, validated, and deployed on time to meet aggressive product launch milestones.This is a US Hybrid (3 days per week) role based in our San Francisco, California office.</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Do:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Program Single Point of Contact (SPOC): Act as the lead representative for Manufacturing Engineering in all PD program forums.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Orchestration: Work in lockstep with Operations Program Managers (OPMs) and Engineering Program Managers (EPMs) to align equipment schedules with the master product schedule. Bring diverse teams together to tackle complex problems and work towards closure.</li> <li>Understand and collaborate in developing the Plan of Record (POR), ensuring qualification plans, checklists and specifications are in place to support production release.</li> <li>Equipment Lifecycle Management: Drive the end-to-end developm

...&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are looking for a Silicon Architect to join Oura’s hardware organization and define the custom silicon that will enable the next generation of our wearable products. In this role, you will gather and synthesize requirements from internal stakeholders, translate product and system needs into clear silicon requirements, and work closely with semiconductor vendors and technology partners to shape the architecture, roadmap, and execution plan for new custom silicon.</p> <p>This is a highly collaborative role spanning product, engineering, operations, and external silicon partners. The ideal candidate brings strong system-level judgment, deep semiconductor knowledge, and the ability to drive clarity and alignment through technically complex and ambiguous problems. This opportunity will be hybrid in San Francisco.</p> <p><strong>What You will do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and communicate custom-silicon architectures for Oura’s future wearable platforms, balancing performance, power, size, schedule, cost, and risk.</li> <li>Gather requirements from product, hardware, firmware, software, algorithms, sensing, and operations teams, and translate them into silicon capabilities, interfaces, performance targets, and power targets</li> <li>Partner with silicon vendors to translate system requirements into silicon requirements, assessing architecture options, and driving execution within product timelines</li> <li>Lead technical discussions and trade-off decisions with vendors across compute, memory, connectivity, security, power, packaging, test, and manufacturing considerations.</li> <li>Work with internal engineering teams and vendors to define validation, characterization, bring-up, and production-readiness plans.</li> <li>Stay current on emerging semiconductor technologies, process capabilities, packaging approaches, and industry trends relevant to wearable health products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We would love to have you on our team,

Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.</p> <p><strong>What we offer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and equity packages</li> <li>Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources</li> <li>An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends &amp; family</li> <li>20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off</li> <li>Paid sick leave and parental leave</li> </ul> <p>Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.</p> <p><strong>Region 1 (SF): $216,000 - $255,000</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="styles--2Kv6p" data-ui="careers-page-content"> <p>ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.
